Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: GLContext

   Stores dynamic OpenGL-related state (VAO, shader, texture handles, etc.).
   Does NOT store raw vertex data.


   .. py:attribute:: vaos
      :type:  dict[str, picogl.backend.modern.core.vertex.array.object.VertexArrayObject]


   .. py:attribute:: vertex_array
      :type:  Optional[picogl.backend.modern.core.vertex.array.object.VertexArrayObject]
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: shader
      :type:  Optional[picogl.backend.modern.core.shader.program.ShaderProgram]
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: texture_id
      :type:  Optional[int]
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: mvp_matrix
      :type:  numpy.ndarray


   .. py:attribute:: model_matrix
      :type:  numpy.ndarray


   .. py:attribute:: view
      :type:  numpy.ndarray


   .. py:attribute:: eye_np
      :type:  numpy.ndarray

      create_shader_program

      :param vertex_source_file: str
      :param fragment_source_file: str
      :param glsl_dir: str
